reviews.author: Chloe C
reviews.text: I needed a pre purchase inspection on a car and they did an amazing job. The mechanic came in early and waited for me while I was on my way. He checked everything and told us everything we needed to know. He was also so patient!

reviews.author: Tatianna Sweeney
reviews.text: Steven and his team are a lifesaver ! After our familys trusted mechanic went out business we were scrambling to find someone we trusted to handle our cars. Steven and his team are very professional, punctual, and fast. They also explain and show everything going on with the car which we appreciate. I highly recommend him to everyone!
